blind.description: A small fantasy or medieval sluice gate featuring two mossy stone pillars with pyramidal caps flanking a wooden gate door reinforced with riveted iron bands. An iron crossbeam spans between the pillars holding a threaded central screw mechanism topped by a large horizontal five-spoked handwheel. Surfaces are clean, solid, and continuous with detailed textures showing weathered stone, wood grain, water/algae staining near the base, and dark cast iron.
blind.from_above: A central circular spoked wheel sitting above a narrow horizontal iron bar, anchored between two square stone pillar tops with pyramidal caps.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 3.2 ft tall (reaching just above the figure's midsection) and about 3.3 ft wide.
